'''''The Price of Victory''''' was the title of a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] depicting one of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] most loyal and trusted servants, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], kneeling before his [[Sith Master/Legends|master]].
